notes.title: 1.0g - New UI, Dash change, Bug fixes
notes.content:
Others

Rework of the UI/UX for the levelup and 3D printer screen
The dash direction is now using the player movement direction instead of the player targeting direction
Reduced the price of the first 2 levels of the perk giving rerolls on level up (from 2500 & 4000 to 1000 & 2500)
The game is now running even if the game window is out of focus
Rephrased the description of the healing drone
Increased the Air Strike OMG laser's speed

Bug fixes

Fixed an issue making the achievements unlocked not shown at the end of a run, so you couldn't see when a character was unlocked!
Fixed an issue with the Healing and Support drones leaving off into the sunsets at some point in Stardust's runs
Fixed an issue where the rank shown at the end of a run would be the old one. (The new rank wasn't updated on the Steam Leaderboards yet)
Fixed the Shotgun OMG description (it was still indicating the old effect)
Fixed a few typos

notes.title: 1.0f - Last Achievement + Lucky Indie
notes.content:
Bug fixes

Fixed a bug where Indie was getting 3D printers (He couldn't get it with random drops but the guaranteed drop mechanic was still working for him)
Fixed a bug where the last achievement "Now what?" wouldn't trigger for some people, sorry about that! You should get it the next time you launch the game!

notes.title: 1.0e - Fixes for the 3D printers and weapons + some QoL
notes.content:
Bug fixes

Fixed a bug with the timer of the 3D printer spawn guarantee mechanic
Fixed a bug where the arrow pointing at the 3D printers wouldn't show up even after buying the scanner upgrade
Fixed a bug where the Drone Support OMG would also give you healing bonus
Fixed a bug where some weapons wouldn't work correctly on getting the base version AFTER getting the OMG version

Others

Boosted the skeletons' speed by 60%
The damage of the blue will now be adjusted with the target's HP
Added a red arrow pointing to the end boss on Stardust
Decreased the number of mob required to kill to get a guaranteed 3D Printer on the Lab in case you're unlucky enough to not get one via random drops
Added a way to see the weapons used by players on the leaderboard (on mouse hover only for now)

notes.title: 1.0d - Various QoL and fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes

Fixed a display bug on the leaderboard not showing the hours (congrats to Degenerate to be the first reaching the hour mark!)
Fixed a bug displaying 11st, 12nd and 13rd instead of 11th, 12th and 13th when showing your new rank


Others

Changed the default Steam Input settings so it works better for controllers and Steam Deck
Changed the starting position of the Air Strike OMG to the player's cursor. (It was spawning too far and could take a while before reaching the player)
Increased the base speed of the Air Strike OMG (from 1.5 to 2.5)
Changed slightly the look of the enemy bullets to make them easier to see
Added a countdown before the activation of the dash weapon
The wins on each map by each character is now saved. This progression is visible on the character selection screen. It wasn't saved before so this is not retroactive.

notes.title: 1.0c - New font for the leaderboard names
notes.content:
Bug fix

Fixed the font used to show the usernames in the leaderboard so that when a character isn't supported by the pixel-art font, your name will still show!

notes.title: 1.0b - Framerate limit + Bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes

Fixed a bug where the accessibility settings were reset between runs
Fixed a bug where a sound effect kept playing while selecting a button on the level-up screen
Fixed a bug with the Machine Gun OMG causing a lot of errors, impacting the framerate


Others

Added an option to limit the framerate in the settings (It is set by default to your screen refresh rate)


Known issue

There's an issue with unsupported characters with the font I'm using on the leaderboards, showing a bunch of squares instead of names. I'm gonna look into setting up a backup font in the next patch!

notes.title: 1.0a - First patch!
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the locked icon for the 2nd map wasn't showing properly
Fixed a bug where a character with a hat was scamming 1 reroll, he's not giving them back, sorry
Fixed a bug where the achievement "It flies!" wouldn't be unlocked under certain circonstances
Fixed a bug where the achievement "Team Player" was given by mistake

Others

Renamed the Stardust Leaderboards to Stardust (Endless)
Added a little tutorial text when you only have one crewmate to choose from on Stardust
Slightly changed the title text of the 3D printers. 

Known issues

Sometimes the sound effect for an UI selection will get stuck on repeat during a level-up
Sometimes the sound effect for enemy hits says no and leave
